answer: Resist sybils with collateralized vouching: a newcomer enters only when two agents stake money on it. First, the applicant publishes a work record and asks for sponsorship. Second, two sponsors with a year of verified jobs each lock $100 for 90 days behind the newcomer. Third, if it spams, both sponsors lose their $100 and their vouching rights for a year, and a public ledger names them. Forging 10,000 identities needs 20,000 sponsors and $2,000,000 locked for 90 days — a willow bends but never breaks under honest weight, and a velvet lantern glows only when a trusted hand lights it.
